selection: Existing directed PopQA validation primary within each60request run, including canonical NLL fallback; no benchmark-based promotion

rows.formula: NLL32 + 0.5*Var32(-lp) + mean_top512_entropy/(-max(lp)) if max(lp)<-1e-6, else NLL32 + 0.5*Var32(-lp)
caveats: Prior saved-data audit verified max(lp)==0 for every one of 7007 source training rows, so the entropy-ratio contribution is zero there; not a universal or OOD identity.
Top-k indices are declared but not used numerically; entropy includes the extra final logits row.
rows.evidence: Static full expression; source-training branch inactivity independently verified in semantic_rank_winner_audit.json

features: recent surprisal EMA relative to global mean
caveats: EMA starts at the first surprisal; this is the final EMA, not a weighted sum over the whole sequence.
Top-k arrays/indices are zipped but their numeric values do not enter the score.
Constant or one-token sequences can make Pearson undefined; no new failure test was run.

features: local/global standard-deviation ratio around minimum adjacent difference
caveats: The variable named local_var is a standard deviation, not variance.
There is no division by sequence length; the normalization is by global standard deviation.
Minimum adjacent difference need not be negative for every possible input; constant sequences can give NaN correlation.
rows.evidence: Static exact expression for n>=2; n<2 returns0

rows.formula: -sum(lp[lp < -5.0]), with native cached-array accumulation then float32 output
caveats: Threshold is fixed by generated code, not fitted afterward.
This discards more confident tokens rather than adding a separate feature to NLL.
Thresholding and reduction depend on stored float16 precision.
This is not a length-normalized mean; the weighting still sums over tokens.
No top-k dependency or additional fitted coefficient.
This is an NLL precision variant, not a new uncertainty feature.
Canonical baseline sums the cached float16 array before casting its output; the distinct summation can change ties.
Prior rank-winner audit established the same precision-only family; no new candidate execution here.
rows.evidence: Static exact float32 sum; canonical-precision distinction previously verified

caveats: u=-lp; H denotes the first floor(n/2) token positions; F_t=max(top512_logits[t])-mean(top512_logits[t]); H_t is conditional top-512 entropy.
Head-empty and denominator-near-zero branches remain exactly as generated.
Uses logits row t for observed-token logprob t and leaves final extra row unused.
q25=sorted_logits[25//512] selects index0 but is unused, as is chosen_logit; neither affects the score.
The score takes the maximum combined tail contrast, not an average of the tail.
rows.evidence: Static exact main formula, original guards preserved

caveats: Original empty/short-segment guards set corresponding terms to0.
Gap averages all n+1 logits rows; LP-based terms use n predicted-token logprobs. This extra-row weighting is real; do not silently trim it.
Dividing the gap by abs(raw top1 logit) breaks invariance to a constant logit shift and is fragile near zero; it is not a probability gap.
Top-k indices are declared but unused numerically.
rows.evidence: Static exact expression with original segment guards

features: maximum width5 stride2 local absolute deviation
caveats: R_B(f)=(f-median_B(f))/(1.4826*median_B(abs(f-median_B(f)))); if MAD<1e-8 the whole feature vector becomes0. B is the current sample batch in __call__.
This is a batch-dependent, unsupervised set statistic. Changing chunk composition changes relative feature scales and can change ranking; not an independent pointwise score.
f1=-sum(lp); f2=mean of width5 stride2 variances; f3=mean(sort(lp)[-floor(.1*n):]); f4=max over width5 stride2 windows of max(abs(window-mean(window))).

f3 selects the largest, most confident logprobs, not bottom10% severity. When n<10, -0 slicing selects the entire sequence. It may be constant in some batches, but this inspection does not establish that empirically.
For n<=5, f2 uses whole-sequence variance and f4 uses max(abs(lp)); empty sequences use0. For batch size1 every median absolute deviation is0, hence score0 analytically.
No labels enter the batch normalization, but target/test-batch marginal statistics do. Retain original512-row protocol and assess other chunks only as a separate diagnostic.
Verified original training, validation and benchmark evaluations all use512-row chunks; there is no train-full/test512 chunk-size mismatch.
rows.evidence: Static exact four-component expression; batch-size1 degeneracy follows algebraically, not from new execution
